status_source: declared in scripts/acceptance_v21.py and cross-checked against the evidence files; not a live measurement of each item

items.title: V1+V2回归与显式覆盖清单
items.note: override matrix and gap analysis are in-repo; the full V1/V2 regression could not be re-executed on this host because PostgreSQL is unavailable (the autouse DB fixture in tests/conftest.py requires it).

items.title: 来源/许可证/许可审计
items.note: probe executed: per-source origin/revision/licence/egress recorded; egress_allowed defaults to false in the manifest and no source is fetched automatically.

items.title: 真实数据 Profile 探针
items.note: AgiBot and LIBERO snapshots are absent; the probe reports BLOCKED with exit code 3 instead of passing. Profiles are registered so the probe will verify them on fetch.

items.title: 不等维 RobotProfile
items.note: unequal dimensions are implemented and tested: libero_franka_sim_v1 is 8/7 and the real locally-verified utokyo snapshot (state[8]/action[7]) resolves through the same profile contract. LIBERO bytes themselves are not present, so V21-04 is not claimed PASS.

items.title: AgiBot关节与夹爪单位
items.note: the schema distinguishes joint/gripper roles and rejects a gripper channel declaring radians; a limits-less profile makes the physics QC NOT_APPLICABLE. The AgiBot channel-to-role mapping cannot be established without meta/agibot_g2_data.json.

items.title: 原生时间与官方Reader往返
items.note: native grid indices are preserved by the clip planner; the export feature block now labels state and action channels from separate name lists (the 8/7 case no longer emits 8 labels for a 7-wide action), and the Reader round-trip compares those labels when the reader reports them. A full 8/7 export+read-back still needs PostgreSQL to drive the pipeline.

items.title: 8s分段1fps抽帧
items.note: 8 s half-open clips, 1 fps integer-second keyframes, <=8 frames, trailing sub-second clip kept, 600 s limit enforced; 21 tests.

items.title: VLM输出严格Schema
items.note: enum/interval/evidence/extra-key/consistency checks all reject without repair; 26 tests.

items.title: VLM replay隔离
items.note: ReplayProvider needs no network, always reports mode=REPLAY, and its results are never live evidence.

items.title: 真实YOLO推理
items.note: real YOLO11n weights on 10 frames decoded from a real public dataset video; weights and source SHA-256 recorded.

items.title: 真实VLM不少于10片段
items.note: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY is not present in this environment; a replay run cannot stand in for ten real model responses.

items.title: 模型异常/预算与外发控制
items.note: 401/403/404/422 fatal, 429/5xx/timeout retryable, truncated body retryable, admission happens under a FOR UPDATE lock on the run row after the balance is read, egress is a pre-condition of any call, and a provider failure is no longer relabelled as 'cannot run the async provider' (ProviderError subclasses RuntimeError).

items.title: VLM超时与双副作用
items.note: at most one committed product is enforced by the (run, clip, provider, model, prompt) unique key plus the lease token; attempts are written through an independent, immediately committed audit session so a rolled-back task cannot erase a call that may have been billed, and `model_call_attempts.cost_state` distinguishes KNOWN / UNKNOWN_UPSTREAM_CHARGE / NOT_BILLED. The DB-level concurrency proof needs PostgreSQL.

items.title: 动作区间人工修订
items.note: ACTION_INTERVAL revisions implemented with If-Match CAS, editor/approver separation delegated to the existing decision service, and 12 unit tests; the HTTP/CAS round-trip needs PostgreSQL.

items.title: Ego与机器人隔离导出
items.note: export_kind column + EGO_ANNOTATION_BUNDLE builder with video-redaction policy, route POST /datasets/{id}/ego-bundle-versions, 15 unit tests; robot versions already reject ego episodes, and a FORMAT_VERIFIED profile can only produce a RESEARCH_SNAPSHOT (publish_level is derived and frozen in the manifest). The archive round-trip needs PostgreSQL + object storage.

items.title: DatasetVersion不可变
items.note: V2 already freezes published DatasetVersions and their manifest SHA; the Ego-bundle immutability regression still needs the export split from V21-15.

items.title: 原子操作并发与故障恢复
items.note: the AI DAG reuses the V1/V2 lease/fence/CAS primitives; one inference per (run, clip, provider, model, prompt) is enforced in code and by a unique key, and a retried task reuses the row instead of creating a second product. The concurrent-worker proof needs PostgreSQL and Redis.

items.note: 100-episode mixed-load benchmark not executed here.

items.note: new runs select pipeline_version 2.1.0 while existing objects keep 2.0.0; a GET-read regression on a V2 object needs PostgreSQL.

items.title: Ego授权或合法替代
items.note: no authorised ego video present; EPIC_EXTERNAL_VERIFIED is NOT_RUN.

items.title: 数据合规与模型许可
items.note: Ultralytics AGPL-3.0 and Qwen2.5-VL usage recorded; no restricted bytes or keys in git. egress_allowed is a NOT NULL DEFAULT false column and both the API and the clip handler refuse a live call without it (SOURCE_EGRESS_NOT_ALLOWED); not exercised against a live provider here.

items.title: 公开数据与模拟数据隔离
items.note: sources carry explicit source_kind/data_origin and the probe keeps real, simulated and fixture data apart; the consolidated report is the gap analysis table.
